promotions.title: Earn or Pay with Flying Blue Miles at ERVERTE Paris
promotions.description: Discover ERVERTE Paris, a premium fashion brand offering timeless clothing and accessories made in France from organic and natural materials. Flying Blue members can earn Miles when paying by card or use their Miles to pay for eligible purchases on erverte.com.
promotions.terms:
Earn Flying Blue Miles when you shop at ERVERTE Paris or use your Miles to pay for eligible purchases.

Miles are awarded on eligible purchases made on erverte.com in accordance with the Flying Blue program rules. The number of Miles earned and the redemption value of Miles may vary depending on the offer displayed on the Flying Blue+ Shopping platform.

Miles are calculated on the net purchase value excluding taxes, shipping fees, and additional services.

Members may also use their Flying Blue Miles as part of the payment for eligible purchases, subject to sufficient Miles balance and program availability.

Standard ERVERTE Paris terms and conditions of sale apply, including shipping, delivery, and return policies.

Miles cannot be exchanged for cash. In the event of cancellation or return, Miles earned may be reversed in accordance with Flying Blue program policies.

ERVERTE Paris reserves the right to modify or terminate this offer at any time without prior notice.
